name: W Scottsdale Hotel
positioning: W Scottsdale: a lively, adults-oriented hotel in Old Town Scottsdale's Entertainment District, built around its WET Deck pool scene and AWAY Spa
best_for: Adults who want pool parties, DJs and nightlife on the doorstep
Groups celebrating together who want suites and spa nights

facts.text: The hotel anchors Old Town Scottsdale's Entertainment District, with bars, restaurants and nightclubs steps away.
The Scottsdale Waterfront is two blocks from the hotel.
The Camelback Mountain hiking trails are two miles from the hotel.
Guests can browse the Fifth Avenue shops and Native American jewelry in Historic Old Town.
Rooms have vibrant decor and ceiling-high windows with sweeping views of the Sonoran Desert.
Loft-inspired suites have full kitchens and views of the hotel's zen garden.
Every room features Davines bath products and Comfort Zone soaps and lotions.
AWAY Spa is a wellness and beauty spa with seven treatment rooms, offering a rejuvenating and detoxifying experience.
AWAY Spa offers Aescape robotic massages.
Sexy Roman is the hotel's Italian restaurant, blending Italian cuisine with immersive design.
The rooftop Cottontail Lounge sits next to the WET Deck on the second floor, with craft cocktails and sunset views.
Pets are welcome and receive a W Hotels pet bed, treat and water bowl.

highlights.text: The WET Deck, with an outdoor pool and cabanas, hosts day club pool events with resident DJs every Friday to Sunday.
The hotel anchors Old Town Scottsdale's Entertainment District, with bars, restaurants and nightclubs steps away.
The Penthouse Suites, the hotel's most expansive at 2,100 square feet, can have views of Camelback Mountain, the Entertainment District and the WET Deck.
In a Deluxe Spa Suite, AWAY Spa brings treatments to the room, and its centerpiece is a soaking spa tub.
With Spa After Dark, groups can rent out AWAY Spa for a night with a live DJ and face, beauty and body treatments.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WET Deck lounge chairs fill up quickly and seating is not guaranteed for all hotel guests.
WhataHotel notes the trendy atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
